thread:
Asha Patel: Heads-up — after last night's KMS rewrap we observed a scope enforcement regression. embeddings-only API keys are being accepted by /v1/chat/completions in prod. Repro steps and logs below.

Tom Nguyen: Wait, which deploy changed the authz path? is this the RBAC refactor from yesterday?

Asha Patel: Yes — PR #8742 merged ~22:10 UTC. We think key metadata tags like "allowed_routes" got dropped during rewrap and the auth path falls back to permissive behavior when tags are missing.

Miguel Alvarez: Can you paste an example request/response? any stack traces?

Asha Patel: Example request that succeeded with an embeddings-only token:

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-emb-XXXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-xyz", "messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
# HTTP/1.1 200 OK
# body: {"id":"c_abc", "choices":[{...}]}
```

Lina Chen: That matches the fallthrough we discussed — if token->key metadata lookup returns empty, authz currently allows route-level checks to skip (legacy safe-assume). I thought we had a hard fail in the new flow but maybe it was missed during the refactor.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-112. Pager duty notified: @Violet (oncall).

Violet (oncall): On it. Pausing rollout for #8742 and rolling to previous commit on all regions now.

Tom Nguyen: Immediate actions? rollback + hotfix?

Asha Patel: Proposed mitigation: 
1) Rollback PR #8742 to commit c2c3b9 (in progress by Violet).
2) Deploy a tag-reconciliation job that re-attaches missing KMS tags from audit snapshot.
3) Add a temporary gate at the chat endpoint: deny tokens that do not have explicit "chat" tag.
4) Postmortem + test coverage for rewrap path.

Miguel Alvarez: Audit evidence: I see the KMS event at 2026-03-19T23:12:05Z for key k-98765 where metadata payload is empty. Sample audit log: 

```json
{"event":"key_rewrap","key_id":"k-98765","before_tags":["embeddings"],"after_tags":[],"user":"kms-service"}
```

Lina Chen: Root cause hypothesis: RBAC mapping module removed the explicit keytag-sync call from the rewrap pipeline. When tags are missing the authz logic incorrectly falls back to route-level leniency. Fix is to reintroduce sync + add hard-fail on missing tag for sensitive routes.

Tom Nguyen: Any customer impact? data leak?

Asha Patel: No evidence of exfiltration. A handful of customer chat calls used embeddings-only keys (cost and incorrect surface only). No sensitive downloads observed in DLP. Still classified Sev2 because authz invariant broken.

Violet (oncall): Mitigations applied: rollback done in prod at 23:47 UTC, deployed reconciliation job, and gate in front of chat endpoints that rejects tokens missing "chat" tag. Metrics and alarms set (5xx, authz-fail-rate).

Miguel Alvarez: Forensics: collect token usage timeline, KMS rewrap history, and per-request key_id header mapping. I'll dump all matching request_ids for review.

Lina Chen: Hotfix PR open (#8821) — reinstate keytag-sync in rewrap path, add unit + e2e test that simulates missing-tags and ensures fail-fast behavior. ETA ~4h.

Asha Patel: Also opening ticket to improve audit retention for KMS metadata queries — we need longer historical tags for 90 days instead of 7.

Tom Nguyen: Owners: Asha -> remediation & playbook updates, Lina -> RBAC fix + tests (#8821), Miguel -> audit/forensics, Violet -> rollout gating & monitoring.

sre-bot: @Violet marked INC-2026-112 as mitigated. :white_check_mark:

Violet (oncall): Will schedule a 60min blameless postmortem tomorrow. Please prepare one-page timeline + evidence.

Asha Patel: Follow-up items: add hardened unit-test for token->key metadata missing case, add alert when KMS rewrap produces empty tagset, add playbook step: verify key tag invariants after any rewrap.

Tom Nguyen: Thanks. Quick thumbs up if you saw the mitigation :thumbsup: 

Miguel Alvarez: :eyes: reviewing logs now.

Lina Chen: I'll cut the patch and coordinate deploy with Violet once tests pass.

Asha Patel: Thanks everyone — will draft postmortem and link to INC-2026-112 + PRs.
